groups: x<0 versus x>=0, fixed before generation

scm.treatment: Bernoulli(0.5) in rct; expit(1.2*x+0.8*w) in observed
scm.potential_coupling: same U,V,delay,measurement noise across D; observed only factual arm
scm.recovery: track flat no-call reference; positive saved energy repaid after release at pmax-3, last grid interval adjusted

truth: CATE conditional on (x,w), integrate U with 80-node Gauss-Legendre and V analytically, delay expectation 30s; noise independent mean zero; verify 160 nodes; Y_star target reported equal in expectation only under this noise design

methods.G0: difference in means, causal only for randomized complete observations
methods.G1: per-arm Ridge(alpha=1.0) on degree-2 PolynomialFeatures(x,w), train-only
methods.G1ML: per-arm HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=60,max_leaf_nodes=7,min_samples_leaf=25,l2_regularization=1,learning_rate=0.05,early_stopping=false), same outcome nuisance as G2
methods.G2: group-crossfit IRM/AIPW; 3 train-user folds; known e=.5 in rct; LogisticRegression(C=1) on x,w in observed; save fold models and training-only full refit models

evaluation: models fit train only; validation diagnostic only/no search; test predictions persisted before evaluator reads truth; target finite test-covariate distribution ATE/GATE; G2 uses holdout factual outcomes for orthogonal score, report separately from new-X effect predictions

support_gate.action: unavailable, never silently clip or drop

F0.source: 3 times declared noise sd; numerical scenario criterion, not business acceptance
F0.stages: no_response,partial,response; power recovery,energy recovery and right censor distinct

F1.candidate: exact penalized piecewise-constant DP, not PELT
F1.scope: only bounded feature development panel, no frozen main-method tuning

metrics: ATE bias and RMSE in proportion/percentage points
GATE RMSE across two predeclared groups
per-replicate paired errors, MC standard error
budget: 20 replicates x 4 scenarios x 1920 events; no model search, no forest, no CI significance claims; small CPU only
decision: G2 remains candidate unless paired errors provide stable increment over same-nuisance G1ML and G1; otherwise downgrade; no test-based retuning
